pack.name: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A Controls
pack.description: Key ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A controls relevant to GRC platforms, focusing on access control (A.5.15-A.5.18), identity management (A.5.16), privileged access (A.8.2), and information classification (A.5.12). Mapped to new 2022 control numbering.
pack.author: GovernexPlus
pack.changelog: Initial release — 12 ISO 27001:2022 Annex A controls

items.name: Access Control Policy (A.5.15)
items.description: Rules to control physical and logical access to information and other associated assets shall be established and implemented based on business and information security requirements.

test_procedure: Review the documented Access Control Policy and confirm it is approved and current
Verify the policy covers need-to-know, need-to-use principles
Confirm policy is communicated to all relevant personnel
Review access request logs to confirm adherence to policy
payload.key_risk: Unauthorized access to information and systems

items.name: Identity Management (A.5.16)
items.description: The full life cycle of identities shall be managed. Unique identifiers shall be assigned to individuals and the identity lifecycle (create, maintain, disable, delete) shall be governed by documented procedures.

test_procedure: Verify all users have unique identifiers (no shared accounts)
Review JML procedures for on-boarding and off-boarding
Confirm disabled/deleted identities cannot be reactivated without re-approval
Test that orphaned accounts are detected and reviewed
payload.key_risk: Shared or orphaned accounts enabling untracked access

items.name: Authentication Information (A.5.17)
items.description: Allocation and management of authentication information shall be controlled by a management process, including advising personnel on appropriate handling of authentication information.

test_procedure: Review password policy settings and compare to minimum requirements
Verify MFA is enforced for privileged accounts
Confirm temporary credentials require change at first logon
Review account lockout configuration
evidence_requirements: MFA enrollment report for privileged accounts
payload.key_risk: Weak authentication enabling unauthorized account compromise

items.name: Access Rights (A.5.18)
items.description: Access rights to information and other associated assets shall be provisioned, reviewed, modified and removed in accordance with the organization's topic-specific access control policy.

test_procedure: Verify formal access provisioning process exists and is followed
Confirm periodic access reviews are performed (at minimum annually)
Test that access changes are authorized and logged
Verify access removal upon role change or termination
payload.key_risk: Excessive access accumulation enabling privilege abuse

items.name: Privileged Access Rights (A.8.2)
items.description: The allocation and use of privileged access rights shall be restricted and managed. Users shall only be granted privileged access when needed and appropriate. Regular reviews of privileged access shall be conducted.

test_procedure: Obtain inventory of all privileged accounts across systems
Verify formal approval exists for each privileged account
Confirm periodic review performed and approved quarterly
Verify privileged accounts are not used for routine tasks
payload.key_risk: Abuse of privileged access to modify systems or extract data

items.name: Information Access Restriction (A.8.3)
items.description: Access to information and application system functions shall be restricted in accordance with the established topic-specific access control policy. Need-to-know and least-privilege principles are enforced.

test_procedure: Review role design for least-privilege adherence
Test that menu and transaction access is restricted to job function
Verify sensitive data fields are masked for unauthorized viewers
Review SoD conflict analysis results
payload.key_risk: Broad access enabling data exfiltration or unauthorized modification

items.name: Classification of Information (A.5.12)
items.description: Information shall be classified according to the information security needs of the organization based on confidentiality, integrity, availability requirements, and criticality.

classification_levels.label: Internal
classification_levels.description: Internal business information — no external disclosure

classification_levels.label: Restricted
classification_levels.description: Highly sensitive — individual need-to-know only (PII, PCI, trade secrets)

test_procedure: Verify classification scheme is documented and approved
Confirm classification is applied to key information assets
Review handling procedures for each classification level
Test that confidential/restricted data has appropriate access controls
payload.key_risk: Inadequate protection of sensitive information due to missing classification

items.name: Logging (A.8.15)
items.description: Logs that record activities, exceptions, faults and other relevant events shall be produced, stored, protected and analysed. Audit trails for security-relevant events are retained for a minimum of 12 months.

test_procedure: Verify audit logging is enabled for all security-relevant events
Confirm logs are retained for minimum 12 months
Test that logs are protected from modification/deletion
Review log monitoring alerts and response procedures
evidence_requirements: Log integrity protection evidence (WORM or digital signing)
payload.key_risk: Inability to detect or investigate unauthorized activities
